# Gram.pl — Spellbound studio retrospective

- Original source: [Tydzień z grą Arcania: Gothic 4 - studio Spellbound Entertainment](https://www.gram.pl/artykul/2010/10/12/tydzien-z-gra-arcania-gothic-4-studio-spellbound-entertainment.shtml)
- Author / publication: Łukasz Wiśniewski; Gram.pl.
- Language / date: Polish; 2010-10-12.
- Access: Article body, including the Robin Hood section, inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

This studio retrospective places Robin Hood within Spellbound’s progression from Desperados toward later projects. Its dedicated section praises the artwork, environmental interaction, story, and recruitment incentive for avoiding violence. It describes the game as using an extensively revised Desperados engine.

The article is useful as evidence of Spellbound’s reputation in Polish games journalism around Arcania’s release. Its broad claim about unusually high review scores is not a reception census, and the proposed connection between Robin Hood’s strengths and the studio winning the Gothic project is explicitly conjectural. Technical and company-history claims require comparison with developer accounts.
